episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Bullied teenager Patty goes to court to defend her fight with a homeless man. Defense attorney Bob sees a chance to redeem himself by helping her.

episodes.title: Skinny Is Magic
episodes.summary: After a suspicious fire at a motel, Patty wonders whether she was at fault. She and Nonnie try to solve the mystery on the first day of senior year.

episodes.title: Miss Bareback Buckaroo
episodes.summary: Bob takes Patty to a pageant in Alabama to meet his former mentor, Stella Rose. Coralee gets an unwelcome visit from her sister.

episodes.title: WMBS
episodes.summary: Patty contemplates what to do with Stella Rose's necklace while also striving to win her first pageant, a mother-daughter event.

episodes.title: Bikinis and Bitches
episodes.summary: Someone hacks Patty's phone and frames her for cyberbullying. Magnolia has an idea on how to save the day. Brick has a heart-to-heart with his dad.

episodes.title: Dunk 'N' Donut
episodes.summary: Nonnie comes to terms with what she wants. Meanwhile, Patty struggles to decide between two love interests and prepares for her baptism.

episodes.title: Miss Magic Jesus
episodes.summary: The ladies get ready for the Miss Magic Jesus pageant and the last-minute Bible trivia quiz. Bob wonders about his connection to Roxy.

episodes.title: Wieners and Losers
episodes.summary: Patty has a very important decision to make about her future. Bob's father tells him to save his marriage with Coralee.

episodes.title: Bad Kitty
episodes.summary: Pastor Mike convinces Patty she has a demon inside of her and Christian offers up a suggestion. Bob grapples with his feelings.

episodes.title: Banana Heart Banana
episodes.summary: Bob Barnard leans in to his truth. Patty plans a charity roast in order to raise money for Dixie. Coralee comes up with a business idea.

episodes.title: Winners Win. Period.
episodes.summary: Patty tries to make amends. The Bobs struggle with how to move forward. Regina believes in Coralee's entrepreneurial plan.

episodes.title: Why Bad Things Happen
episodes.summary: Nonnie and Brick search for Patty when she goes missing. Bob is faced with a seemingly impossible decision. Regina gives Christian advice.

episodes.title: Pig
episodes.summary: Patty and Bob work frantically to cover up her crimes and are met with a few surprises. The regionals queen is given her crown.

episodes.title: Dead Girl
episodes.summary: While the police investigate the recent murder, Patty works to unite the pageant contestants in a public relations attempt to change the headlines.

episodes.title: Boomerang
episodes.summary: Patty finds an eating disorder sponsor and meets a significant person. Bob takes on a new client. Coralee encourages Bob Barnard to run for mayor.

episodes.title: Poison Patty
episodes.summary: Coralee and Regina throw a feminist period party. Bob goes polyamorous speed dating. Patty is haunted by visions while mentoring a "little sister."

episodes.title: Finding Magnolia
episodes.summary: Magnolia visits Hughes University to try to piece together her lost memories. Dixie learns a shocking secret. Bob launches his mayoral campaign.

episodes.title: Eat and Run
episodes.summary: A crushed Patty throws herself into her newfound talent with the help of a tempting instructor. Brick decides he wants to be a social media influencer.

episodes.title: Full Brazilian
episodes.summary: Nonnie investigates a crime. Patty competes in the state pageant while simultaneously working her recovery program. Angie encounters trouble.

episodes.title: Pretty in Prison
episodes.summary: A tragedy lands Patty in prison, where she helps plan a pageant. Meanwhile, Coralee and Bob's division of their home results in a surprise.

episodes.title: Ladybomb
episodes.summary: The Bobs face off in a heated debate with quite a few twists, while Coralee tries to remove herself from danger. Patty and Nonnie go on a ghost tour.

episodes.title: The Most You You Can Be
episodes.summary: The Miss American Lady pageant declares its winner as shocking truths come to light, and Patty embraces her inner self, much to Bob's dismay.
